4. Perused the office report dated 17.10.2023 and the settlement agreement dated 13.10.2023 which indicates that matter has been peacefully settled between the parties and they have settled their differences on the terms mentioned in paragraph 6 of the settlement agreement dated 13.10.2023.

The paragraph 7 is quoted as under:-
"7.

The following settlement has been arrived at between the parties hereto:-
a) That the parties stated that they have been living together as husband and wife since August, 2023 forgetting all previous disputes and differences.
In continuation of the aforesaid reunion, the parties appeared and stated that they are full satisfied with this reunion and further they want to continue it for the rest of their lives.
b) That the husband and wife undertake that they shall not take any such action which may hurt either of the party mentally or physically and shall try to satisfy each other by their activities.
c) That the parties undertake not to commit any kind of cruelty against each other in any manner whatsoever.
d) That it has been agreed between the parties that they will behave properly living in peaceful and cordial atmosphere.
e) That the husband undertakes to take care of his wife and daughters and fulfill all essential requirements and amenities to them in future.
f) That it has been agreed between the parties in their peaceful living and cordial atmosphere.

g) That it has also been agreed between the parties that all the cases filed by them against each other and their family members regarding present matrimonial dispute shall be withdrawn by the parties concerned by taking appropriate steps before the Court/authority concerned.
h) That the parties will not file any fresh case against each other or their family members in respect of this matrimonial dispute.
They have no claim against each other in future also.
i) That it has been agreed between the parties that they shall not violate the terms and conditions of this settlement otherwise the aggrieved party will be free to take legal recourse."
